headline: Second empty day in a row; minimal drift
body: Another quiet day with no scored events. The same gentle fade of older stories continued, and no line moved more than a few hundredths. The board still reflects the late-June mix of gated frontier models and alignment worries. Horizon Balance: +1.41.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.05 and Enslaved God -0.05.
